The '''Asher system''' was located in the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial astronomical object [[Asher III]].<ref name="SS" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a [[Rebel cell (Asher III)|cell]] on Asher III. Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="SS" /> of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tracked down the Asher III cell and moved to [[Destruction of Asher III Rebel cell|destroy]] the Rebel presence there, eliminating most of it. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Lernik De'Yago]], who was on the celestial body at the [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the Rebel [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|starship]] ''[[Nova Whisper]]'' and used it to escape Asher III.<ref name="SS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Asher system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
